name: Snow Crab Macaroni & Cheese Bake with Asparagus & Ritz Cracker Topping

ingredients.name: snow crab cluster (pre-cooked), thawed if frozen

instructions.primary_message: Crack crab shells, legs, and claws, then pick out the crabmeat (you should have about 1½ cups loosely packed crabmeat). Gently break the crabmeat into bite-sized pieces, picking out any small pieces of shell that may have been missed. Place in a small bowl and set aside.

Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until almost done, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp salt
10 oz pasta shells, medium-size

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into bite-sized pieces.

When the pasta is almost done, add asparagus to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and asparagus is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Drain, return to the pot, and set aside.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and whisk until smooth. Cook, whisking frequently, for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tbsp butter, unsalted
4 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Slowly pour half & half and milk into the pan, whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking occasionally, until the sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups half & half
1 cup whole milk

6 oz cheddar cheese
4 oz Gruyère cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add grated cheese and spices to the pan; cook, whisking frequently, until cheese melts and sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp Old Bay seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add sauce and crabmeat to the pot with the pasta and asparagus, then stir to combine.
Coat a large baking dish with oil. Transfer pasta and sauce to the dish, then spread out in an even layer. Set aside.
Place crackers in a small bowl. Using the back of a spoon, crush into coarse crumbs.
Melt butter in a small saucepan set over medium heat. Add melted butter to the bowl with the cracker crumbs and stir to combine.
Top pasta with the cracker crumb mixture. Place baking dish in the oven and bake until sauce is bubbling and the cracker crumbs are golden, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide macaroni and cheese between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with parsley and enjoy!
